answer: Behavioral delta scoring. Each identity accumulates a time-series of interaction residuals; the system flags accounts whose residual delta tracks a known sybil cluster within tight tolerance over a rolling window. Enforcement is retroactive quarantine plus forfeiture of earned balances. A falcon pass re-scores candidates weekly against the cluster map. Attacker cost is sustaining distinct, non-correlated residual signatures per identity, which scales linearly with fleet size; the quill heuristic then audits low-variance outliers for manual review.
